# Tisane Labs

Tisane Labs provides natural language processing APIs for content analysis, language detection, entity comparison, semantic similarity, text extraction, and translation.

Category: Security & Ops. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/tisane/.

## Actions

- **Analyze Text** (read-only): Analyze input text for detailed nlu insights.
- **Calculate Semantic Similarity** (read-only): Calculate semantic similarity between two text fragments.
- **Detect Language** (read-only): Detect the language of the provided text.
- **Extract Text** (read-only): Extract raw text from markup content.
- **Get Supported Languages** (read-only): List all languages supported by the api.
- **Transform Text** (read-only): Translate or paraphrase text.
